id.description: Id of the component, used as source of the `Story.Saved` and `Story.Deleted` events.

previewPage.description:
Page opened by the "preview" link of the story, with `?story=<iri>` added. Usually the page
with the components the story drives, e.g. `/resource/:test`. When empty, the state URL of
the first slide is used.

story.description: IRI of the story to edit. Without it a new story is created.
